WITH pair_averages AS (
    SELECT f.orderslink,
           u.acctscope,
           AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_fee_rate
    FROM fees AS f
    JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
    JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
    GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope
), scored AS (
    SELECT orderslink,
           acctscope,
           avg_fee_rate,
           avg_fee_rate - AVG(avg_fee_rate) OVER () AS excess
    FROM pair_averages
), ranked AS (
    SELECT orderslink,
           acctscope,
           avg_fee_rate,
           excess,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC) AS pair_rank
    FROM scored
    WHERE excess > 0
)
SELECT orderslink,
       acctscope,
       avg_fee_rate,
       excess,
       pair_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE pair_rank <= 3
ORDER BY acctscope, pair_rank, orderslink;

assumptions.assumption: The mean of all pair averages is the unweighted arithmetic mean across matched (orderslink, account scope) pairs; pairs with no non-NULL feerate have no average and are excluded.
